decisions.decision: Use invalidateAll() for all polling on both list and detail pages
decisions.rationale: Direct fetch('/admin/pipeline', Accept: application/json) silently routed to SvelteKit page handler on the static route, returning HTML 200 — res.ok true but res.json() threw SyntaxError swallowed in async setInterval callback. invalidateAll() re-runs the server load function which is the idiomatic SvelteKit pattern and confirmed working.

decisions.decision: On terminal state transition, detail page calls invalidateAll() once to refresh data.argument and data.participants
decisions.rationale: Those props come from the initial server load (+page.server.ts) and are not covered by the per-second job polling via +server.ts. Without this, post-completion UI sections (ParticipantList, Create Argument button) stayed hidden until manual reload.
